versions.statuteQuote: A landlord shall offer a prospective tenant a written rental agreement containing the terms governing the rental of the dwelling unit and setting forth the terms and conditions of the landlord-tenant relationship and shall provide with it the statement of tenant rights and responsibilities developed by the Department of Housing and Community Development and posted on its website pursuant to § 36-139.

A landlord shall offer a prospective tenant a written rental agreement containing the terms governing the rental of the dwelling unit and setting forth the terms and conditions of the landlord-tenant relationship and shall provide with it the statement of tenant rights and responsibilities developed by the Department of Housing and Community Development and posted on its website pursuant to § 36-139.

summaryForModel: The landlord must offer a written lease and provide with it the Virginia DHCD Statement of Tenant Rights and Responsibilities. Both parties sign a DHCD form acknowledging the tenant received it. Flag a lease that does not mention or attach the statement.
paraphraseExamples: Attached as Exhibit C: Statement of Tenant Rights and Responsibilities.
Tenant acknowledges receipt of the Virginia Statement of Tenant Rights and Responsibilities.
tenantExplanation: Your landlord must give you Virginia's official Statement of Tenant Rights and Responsibilities with your lease. It explains your rights in plain language.
action: If it isn't attached, ask your landlord for the Statement of Tenant Rights and Responsibilities before you sign.
